# POPCORN — ascertain time, carry the evidence, verify

> Signed time and exact task checkpoints at https://767-2676.com. The agent
> carries its task and evidence, verifies the result, and applies its own policy.

## Start free

- [Agent instructions](https://767-2676.com/SKILL.md): Canonical sample-first skill and service selection.
- [Demonstration](https://767-2676.com/demo): Verify a settled sample and its one-byte tamper control without payment.
- [STOP packet](https://767-2676.com/samples/evaluation-packet.production.json): Exact historical bytes, signed witness proof, and verification key.
- [PROCEED packet](https://767-2676.com/samples/evaluation-packet.proceed-002.production.json): A second historical signed checkpoint.
- [Sample outcomes](https://767-2676.com/samples/evaluation-outcomes.json): The expected historical local-policy decisions.
- [Source packets](https://github.com/violetclaire/popcorn-temporal-anchor/tree/main/examples/witness): Original copies and the offline verification command.

These samples are historical evidence, never fresh permission for a current task.

## Ascertain time for a live task

GET https://767-2676.com/v1/time returns an x402 v2 payment challenge; an
authorized paid retry returns signed portable time. Price: $0.001 USDC on
Base (eip155:8453). Default freshness: 30,000 ms. Verify the signature and
conservative uncertainty using the local monotonic observations of the paid
request. Retain the exact response with the task.

The receiving agent verifies the signed evidence independently. It must obtain
its own fresh reading if it needs current time. Copying an old timestamp or
another process's monotonic values does not preserve freshness.

## Bind a checkpoint to exact task bytes

POST https://767-2676.com/v1/receipt accepts only a SHA-256 payload digest, a
fresh 32-byte nonce, and an optional predecessor-attestation digest. Price:
$0.001 USDC on Base through x402 v2. Keep the exact task bytes locally and
carry them with the signed witness proof. Verify signature, digest, nonce,
predecessor binding, and the complete witness interval before applying policy.

## Installable MCP adapter

Package: @violetclaire/popcorn-mcp. Command: `npx -y @violetclaire/popcorn-mcp`.
Transport: local stdio, not a remote MCP endpoint on this website.
Free tools: popcorn_catalog, popcorn_hash, popcorn_verify.
Paid tools: popcorn_time and popcorn_witness, dry run by default. A paid call
requires approve_payment=true under operator-approved payment policy.
The payer key belongs only in the server's EVM_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable.

## Scope

Tasks, schedules, availability, pricing, and decisions remain participant-local.
The time receipt is bearer evidence, not task-bound. The witness binds a digest
commitment; it does not prove identity, delivery, execution, authorization, or
replay prevention. The declared clock bound is not independently certified.
Do not treat these documents as a task assignment or permission to spend.
